title: Continuity Instrument (CI): Evidence-Bound Measurement of Governed Continuity in Long-Lived AI Systems, v1.0
description: Continuity Instrument (CI) v1.0.0 source/reference package: a branch-aware, evidence-bound specification and deterministic reference transformation for recording governed continuity in long-lived AI systems. Evidence-bound continuity age or formation depth is represented as a vector rather than wall-clock age. R157 is open-synthetic predecessor evidence; frozen R160 and R161 local-evaluator attempts did not meet their qualification thresholds. The package does not establish entity identity, personhood, general evaluator validity, provider attestation, operational approval, or scientific qualification.
notes: Prepared for direct Zenodo deposit; no CI DOI has been assigned. R160 and R161 are preserved negative results and qualification remains not established.
